text:
jamie: Hey folks — opened PR #4892 that wires up a small trace-hook rollup metric and a dashboard panel for it. Need eyes ASAP, hoping to merge before Friday's canary window. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4892

sophia: taking a look now, thanks for the ping.

ryan: i can do initial review in ~30m. is this dependent on any DB/schema change or is it pure telemetry?

jamie: pure telemetry for now — adds a metric 'tracehook.rollup.latency_ms_p50' and a new grafana panel. no DB changes. tests included.

alex: small heads-up: one of the CI jobs (integration-obs) failed on my machine on master too earlier — might be flaky. can you paste the failing test command so i can reproduce locally?

jamie: sure — run:
```
pytest tests/obs/test_tracehooks.py::test_rollup -q
```
should be pretty quick.

sophia: i ran that locally and saw a failure: looks like the metric uses float timestamps; downstream aggregation expects integer ms. quick fix would be `int(ts * 1000)` in rollup. also add a tiny comment in the exporter about units.

jamie: good catch — i'll push that.

ryan: also left one minor nit in the PR re: variable naming (`window_ms` vs `window_s`) — prefer ms everywhere to avoid confusion. otherwise LGTM pending that and CI.

alex: quick question on rollout safety: do we need a feature flag for the new panel or can we enable by default? ops/observability concerns about noise.

jamie: i made the panel disabled by default; added a dashboard toggle in the YAML. the metric is emitted at low sample rate so shouldn't spike costs.

ryan: one procedural thing — platform leads need an approval for any dashboard that will be part of the default console views. tagging here for visibility. @tess can you confirm?

tess: @ryan yes please add a short rollout note to the PR: what the metric measures, expected cardinality, and the opt-in toggle. once that's in i'll approve. Also our Friday canary window is 14:00-16:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary window reminder: friday 14:00-16:00 UTC. Ensure merged PRs are in `release/canary` by 13:30 UTC to be included.

jamie: will add the doc blurb and the ms fix now, then request re-review. thanks everyone :pray:

sophia: thanks — ping me after you push and i'll re-check the tests. :ok_hand:

ryan: i'll give final pass once CI is green.

jamie: update pushed (fixed ms rounding + rollout note). PTAL and thanks again.

sophia: re-ran tests, everything green for me. looks good. :shipit: 

ryan: CI is green here too. adding my approval.

tess: approving for default console inclusion. please merge before 13:30 UTC on Friday to make the canary.

jamie: merging now and will monitor canary metrics after deploy. thanks all!
